title: ONE 5 KT NUKE
ON BATAN ISLAND
yt_title: One Nuke on Batan Island: China Fires First in a Pacific War #shorts
hook: A single DF-26 flies six minutes and a 5 kt nuke bursts over an island airport: the simulated day six of a US-China war.

title: THE 5 PSI RING
STOPS AT THE TOWN
yt_title: What One Nuke Would Do to Batan Island's Airport #shorts
hook: The fireball is 116 metres wide, the airport is destroyed and the 5 psi ring stops just short of the town: the rings of a 5 kt air burst.

title: THE LRASM RUNS OUT
ON DAY FOUR

hook: In the simulated Pacific war the US anti-ship missile is gone by day four, so a bomber switches to the next round.
